labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: pip-audit advisories (CVE-2026-4539 for pygments, CVE-2026-25645 for requests) concern dependency packages, not Rich code.

body:
The advisories in this report concern dependency packages (Pygments and Requests), as reported by pip-audit, not a change in Rich itself. Any fix would come from those upstream projects. For this kind of concern, see the vulnerability reporting process in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md rather than a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
